bio.text: Lorena Austin is a Democratic member of the Arizona House of Representatives for District 9, according to the Arizona Legislature's member page.
According to the 2024 candidate-submitted voter guide, Austin is a fifth-generation Arizonan and Mesa native, and a former public educator with the Maricopa Community Colleges.
The 2024 profile says Austin graduated from Mesa Community College and Arizona State University and has work experience in the nonprofit and private sectors.

sources.title: Voter Education Guide, 2024 primary: Legislative District 9 (candidate-submitted statements)
